iac.name: IaC 覆盖（compose / systemd / nginx / 监控）
iac.headline: checkov and trivy config scanned ZERO files in deploy/. KICS genuinely covered compose.yaml (10 MEDIUM). systemd units and the nginx config have NO automated coverage at all.
key_findings: No blockchain-* systemd unit is installed or active on the deployment host; the platform runs as bare processes (api pid 3413432, worker pid 3413434, vite dev server bound to 0.0.0.0:3000, preview servers on 3001/3002, MCP on 127.0.0.1:8090, host nginx 1.24.0).
None of the 8 systemd units has ANY sandbox hardening (NoNewPrivileges / ProtectSystem / ProtectHome / PrivateTmp / CapabilityBoundingSet / dedicated User=).
nginx CSP, X-Content-Type-Options and Referrer-Policy apply only to /admin/ and /app-v2/; location /, /api/, /mcp, /openapi.json, /docs and /redoc have none. No HSTS and no server_tokens off.
Positive: the nginx log_format uses $uri rather than $request_uri, so query-string secrets never reach the access logs — this is why the log secret scan is clean.
Positive: every compose port binds to 127.0.0.1 only.
The deployed nginx config is byte-identical to the repo version (sha256 200ef752...c9ccab).

secrets.name: 秘密扫描（AUDIT-002 / §23.8）
secrets.headline: Runtime LOGS are clean (0 hits over 69 sources, 191,904 lines, 30 MB). But 7 production secrets are embedded in all three shipped Go binaries, and the same production Postgres / ClickHouse passwords sit in the git-tracked deploy/.env.example.

repo.note: The 164 candidates are overwhelmingly TypeScript/Go type annotations such as password: string, apiKey: string, token: TokenView; 57 of them sit in the non-release .codex-backups tree. The material exception is deploy/.env.example.
repo.checkov_secrets_triage: all 13 are the page_token_hash field in artifacts/v142_p0/**/*.json — hashes of pagination cursors, not credentials. FALSE POSITIVES.

git_tracked_exposure.note: .env is gitignored so deploy/.env itself is not committed, but the same credentials were copied into the tracked .env.example, bypassing that control.
